title: Largest plus smallest neighbour factor
plain: Add the largest prime factor of n to the smallest prime factor of n + 1. Tested starts reach 5 → 7 → 9 or 22 → 34. Prove all do.
math: For $f(n)=P(n)+p(n+1)$, with $p$ the least prime factor, prove every orbit with $n\ge3$ reaches $(5,7,9)$ or $(22,34)$.
